en.settings.announceToAgent: Announce the task board to agents
en.settings.announceToAgentHint: On: every agent system prompt includes a note about this board. Off: no announcement; agents learn about the board only when you mention it.
en.settings.description: Task orchestration, agent announcement and goal acceptance.
en.settings.enabledCardHint: Master switch, announcement, sleep protection and subtask depth.
en.settings.enabledHint: When off, the sidebar entry and board view are hidden and the task_board_* agent tools are unregistered; while on, any session can read and drive the board, its subtasks and its schedules through those tools.
en.settings.goalVerificationCardHint: The switch, the judge model and the criteria threshold.
en.settings.goalVerificationEffortFallback: The selected reasoning effort {requested} is not supported by the target model; it falls back to {resolved}.
en.settings.goalVerificationEffortFallbackN: The selected reasoning effort {requested} is not supported by the target model; it falls back to that model default level (not sent explicitly).
en.settings.goalVerificationEffortHint: Blank inherits the host default level. A level the target model does not declare is never sent blindly: the acceptance falls back to that model own default level, and the fallback is reported below.
en.settings.goalVerificationHint: On by default: a task executed in goal form must pass one acceptance before update_goal may mark it complete (the three coding criteria, aimed at engineering tasks, a 0.65 threshold, two rounds per criterion with the A/B slots swapped, and the work must beat the empty-work baseline). A first failure returns the total, the per-criterion scores and the located findings to the fixing agent, and one execution may accept at most twice; a second failure fails that execution. It affects only this board goal-form executions, never plain chat and never a task pinned to goalRun: false. Every acceptance really calls the judge model and spends quota.
en.settings.goalVerificationModelHint: Blank inherits the host: the default route of the host model catalog, never the card pinned execution model.
en.settings.goalVerificationModelInvalid: The configured judge model is not a provider/model route; the host default is used instead.
en.settings.goalVerificationResolvedNoEffor: Reasoning effort: not sent explicitly (the model default)
en.settings.goalVerificationResolvedPreset: Rubric: coding (Specification Adherence / Output Match / Error Signal Detection), threshold {threshold}
en.settings.goalVerificationRouteMissing: The host serves no model catalog, so no judge route resolves: with acceptance on, a goal completion claim is refused and recorded as an acceptance anomaly.
en.settings.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.settings.maxSubtaskDepthHint: Default 1: a task may carry one level of subtasks, and a subtask cannot create or link further subtasks. Maximum 3. Running a task also runs its whole subtask tree concurrently, and every extra level opens more sessions per run.
en.settings.notExposed: This DSH version does not expose this plugin's settings namespace to the configuration page, so the form is unavailable. Edit ~/.dsh/settings.yaml directly, or add the namespace to the Host settings allowlist and restart.
en.settings.powerBoundary: This may use more battery. Lid close, manual sleep, hibernation, shutdown, low-battery actions, and enterprise policy are outside the guarantee; an already sleeping computer is not woken.
en.settings.powerStatus: Platform: {platform}; protection: {phase}; running sessions: {running}; enabled schedules: {schedules}
en.settings.preventIdleSleepHint: Off by default. When enabled, the Host prevents idle system sleep while any DSH session runs, any schedule is enabled, or session state is not yet known. The display may still turn off.
